commands.title: Set Game Day
commands.description: Sets the world clock to the given in-game day.

commands.title: PalDefender Commands
commands.description: Generates a /killnearestbase console command for every base camp. Returns the lines in its result for copying rather than writing them to a log file.

commands.title: Resize One Container
commands.description: Sets one container's slot count by id. Refuses rather than dropping slots that still hold items.

commands.title: Resize All Player Inventories
commands.description: Sets every player's main inventory to the given slot count. Refuses per player rather than dropping slots that still hold items.

commands.title: Resize All Guild Chests
commands.description: Sets every guild storage container to the given slot count. Refuses per container rather than dropping slots that still hold items.

commands.title: Unlock All Private Chests
commands.description: Clears the ownership lock on every private chest and item booth in the world so any player can open them.
